quick_skim.title: A conservative coupling method of sharp-interface and multi-species model for compressible reacting gas-liquid flows with phase change
quick_skim.abstract: In this paper, a conservative sharp-interface and diffuse-interface coupling method is developed for compressible two-phase multi-species flows with phase change and chemical reactions. The liquid--gas interface is represented by a sharp-interface model, whereas a diffuse-interface model treats the transport and chemical reactions of gas-phase species. Conservation is enforced by coupling the two phases through interfacial fluxes obtained from a multi-species phase-change Riemann problem. The original single-species four-wave Riemann solver is extended to multi-species gas mixtures by modifying the interfacial energy jump condition. Interfacial mass transfer is restricted to the condensable vapor species. Accordingly, both the interfacial energy jump condition and the gas-mixture energy-exchange flux are constructed using the internal energy of the phase-changing vapor species rather than the mixture internal energy. With this species-selective energy coupling, an approximate multi-species Riemann solver is constructed that retains the four-wave structure while avoiding the multidimensional nonlinear root-finding required by the exact solution. A series of numerical tests, including impulsive evaporation and condensation, reacting aluminum vaporization, shock-droplet interaction, and detonation-droplet interaction, are performed to assess the accuracy and robustness of the method. The numerical results agree well with reference solutions and benchmark data, demonstrating that the present method resolves the effects of phase change and chemical reactions in compressible multi-species multiphase flows while preserving conservative interfacial coupling.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Develops a conservative sharp-interface/diffuse-interface coupling method for compressible two-phase multi-species flows with phase change. Extends Riemann solver for multi-species interfacial mass transfer. Relevant to multiphase CFD and falling film evaporation.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该论文针对可压缩气液两相多组分流动中相变与化学反应的数值模拟难题，提出了一种尖锐界面与扩散界面耦合的守恒方法。液相用尖锐界面描述，气相组分输运用扩散界面模型，通过多组分相变黎曼问题实现界面通量守恒耦合。该方法扩展了原四波黎曼求解器，为涉及蒸发和反应的多组分两相流模拟提供了新工具，可用于降膜蒸发等涉及气液相变与组分输运的多相流CFD模拟。
